description: This file defines the Tabs3 class, a subclass of TabActivity, which creates a tabbed interface with three tabs, each launching different activities, demonstrating tab management in an Android application.

classes.name: Tabs3
classes.description: Defines a tabbed activity with three tabs, each launching a different activity, illustrating the usage of TabHost in Android.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the tab activity and sets up three tabs with intents to launch different activities, including a flag to recreate a tab when clicked.
